memories.title: 部分监管划转金额计算缺失分支与字段监听
memories.content: zhi2-web-admin/src/views/v1/presale/stock/agreement/detail.vue 中，全额监管切部分监管时 regulatoryAmount 未清空且 watch 浅监听未触发重算，致 transferAmount 错误。setregulatory 增加部分监管分支清空金额，watch 监听 form.contractAmount 与 form.regulatoryAmount，moneyCalculation 按监管类型("1"/"2")算 transferAmount 并于 getDetail 及 @input 调用。
